text:
mina (PM): Quick decision needed: Milestone 8 cutline. Exec asked for a short, defensible list of what ships in MVP vs v1 by EOD. My draft: MVP = embeddings cache, basic SSO, per-tenant rate limits, and CSV export. Defer tenant dashboards, advanced quant profiles, and admin analytics to v1. Also propose offering 3 pilot slots for top customers with a migration concession. Thoughts?
chris (eng): Agree on keeps. Dashboards + ETL are >3 sprints. One ask: CSV export has to support incremental export for large tenants; estimate +4 dev days.
deepa (eng-ml): embeddings cache is mandatory for our 95p latency SLO. Also suggest a canary eval for duplicate-token rate and a short-circuit fallback to un-cached model if rate spikes. I'll write the eval gate.
owen (design): If we pull dashboards, we should ship a lightweight placeholder that surfaces pilot signup + a "limited metrics" banner. I can ship mocks today for the placeholder + CSV UX.
sam (sales): FluxHealth and NeonApps specifically requested dashboards. They'll accept pilot access if we commit internal ETA and provide migration assistance. I can lock pilots but need legal-approved terms.
tess (prod-ops): Recommend feature_flag: limited-metrics and pilot mode. Will add runbook entries for CS and ops. Also call out rollback plan if pilot telemetry causes storage spikes.
mina (PM): Proposal for customer messaging: offer pilot slots (3), provide a migration script, and no public v1 date; internal ETA = next quarter. Sam, can you secure pilots? Legal, can we get a one-page pilot TOS?
legal-bot: Please route pilot TOS to @legal-team. Typical timeline for review: 48-72 hours. Include data retention and support SLAs in the draft.
chris (eng): Dev cutlist + quick patch notes:
```
- ship (MVP): embeddings-cache, basic-SSO (OIDC), per-tenant rate limits, csv-export endpoint
- add: feature_flag limited-metrics, pilot-signup endpoint, cache-fallback hook for high duplicate-rate
- defer (v1): tenant dashboard UI + ETL pipeline, advanced quant profiles, admin analytics tooling
```
deeepa (eng-ml): I'll add a small canary test: if duplicate-token-rate > 1.5x baseline on canary, disable cache fallback and notify team. Posting PR by noon.
owen (design): Mocks + copy for placeholder dashboard and CSV export uploaded to Figma; link in thread. Also created a short CTA for pilot signups.
sam (sales): I'll message FluxHealth + NeonApps and try to confirm 2 pilot slots today; will ask for quick consent on migration assistance.
tess (prod-ops): Drafting release notes and internal CS playbook now. Will include migration script instructions and rollback checklist.
mina (PM): Action items recap: Chris -> updated dev estimates + migration delta by 11:30; Deepa -> eval PR + canary rule by noon; Owen -> final mocks + export UX by 4pm; Tess -> release notes + runbook by EOD; Sam -> pilot confirmations + list by EOD; Legal -> TOS turnaround. I'll update milestone board after estimates are in. Thanks all :thumbsup:
